reason: My doctor said my magnesium could be low, so this hits a real problem for me. The lab report for the batch and the money-back guarantee make one box at $24.99 an easy impulse buy.
objection: Sachets feel like more packaging waste, 30 foil packets a month for something that could just be a bottle. I also don't know if 200 mg is the right amount for me until I talk to my doctor.
